leads.name: Messikomer Eich
leads.species_basis: genus read from the tree's own name; ask the reader which species
leads.why: Verified and NOT shipped, 2026-08-29, on the day-trip boundary rather than on the tree. Over 500 years, girth over 6 m, protected by the Seegraeben council in 1914 and named for Jakob Messikommer in 1927; struck by lightning in 2005, and a tomography reported in the Zuercher Oberlaender on 4 August 2011 concluded it could stand for years yet, with follow-up testing every two or three years. Sources: wetzipedia.ch and zo-online.ch. It sits at Robenhausen by the Pfaeffikersee, which is roughly 50 minutes from Zurich by S-Bahn plus a walk, so it fails CLAUDE.md's roughly-30-minutes test for the Zurich page. Ship it if Wetzikon ever gets its own page, or if the boundary is reconsidered. Species not established.
